intended_object: This is an auxiliary height function, built for one specific configuration ("chipped triangle" at target vertex 4), that a certificate uses in the genus-five Brill–Noether graph case analysis (row 09, degree specs on 8 vertices and 12 edges). I inferred this from the docstring, the name and how it is used in the same file (`Profile d noMark (heightT4 d)`, `contribForm`).
explanation: The definition puts together three helper quantities, `hcT4`, `htT4` and `hvT4`, as a function on `Fin 8`. It is nonzero only at vertices 3, 4 and 5. It exists to verify a specific case in a computer-checked certificate, namely the coefficient identity `allocT4 d v + contribForm d (heightT4 d) v = t4Coeff d v`. It has no counterpart in standard mathematics; it is an internal proof device.
